name: Scramble Lovers
original_name: スクランブル・ラバーズ
source:
One day during lunchtime, Shingo gathered with four girls who had transferred into the same class as him. His twin sister Yui suggested that they undergo ‘love training’ in order to find a wonderful first love. He thought he had heard her wrong, but the other girls all readily accepted the idea. Thus, the first love agreement was formed. It contained 5 articles: 1) one must report all activities, 2) one can try anything they wish, 3) one should not forestall others, 4) one should tell others if there is any progress in their situation, and 5) if anyone reaches the goal, then everyone else should offer them their congratulations. With the summer festival as the deadline, the girls begin their quest for first love.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/06/11/june-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一天午休時，慎吾和四名轉入同班的女孩聚在一起。他的雙胞胎妹妹結衣提議，為了找到美好的初戀，大家進行「戀愛訓練」。他以為自己聽錯了，但其他女孩都爽快地接受了這個想法。於是，初戀協定成立了。協定裡有五項約定：1）必須報告所有活動；2）可以嘗試自己想做的任何事；3）不得搶在其他人之前；4）情況有進展時要告訴大家；5）有人達成目標後，其他人都要向她表示祝賀。女孩們把夏日祭定為期限，開始了尋找初戀的旅程。

［來源：[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/06/11/june-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
